Just like my previous project for https://e-hentai.org/g/3392510/46b53aa71e/
I've created a new scene player for the game that lets you access all stories, events, and animations.

播放器下载地址: https://mega.nz/folder/8NtUDTgJ#m79BHA0juh8crclVOsvgqw
Demo预览: https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/64d1ab88-3eb6-4a72-b131-0bef3d241574
需要下载字体，对应的游戏配置，操作系统对应的版本共3个文件，把它们解压到同一目录

播放器使用说明
本工具不包含任何游戏资源文件！ 为了尊重版权并规避法律风险（DMCA），你必须自行提取游戏资源。解包可参考这篇教程
https://live2dhub.com/t/topic/3519

将提取出的资源文件按Unity3D的container结构放入 assets 文件夹中。请务必确保与下方列表完全一致：

音频文件
assets/advscene/resources/advscene/sound/**.m4a

贴图与Spine动画
assets/advscene/resources/advscene/texture/**.png
assets/advscene/resources/advscene/texture/**.atlas
assets/advscene/resources/advscene/texture/**.prefab
魔物娘td
assets/resources/character/**.png
assets/resources/character/**.atlas
assets/resources/character/**.prefab
拉莱耶少女队
assets/assetbundleresources/character/**.png
assets/assetbundleresources/character/**.atlas
assets/assetbundleresources/character/**.prefab

游戏索引
assets/advscene/scenariochapter/config.chapter.json

剧情脚本
assets/advscene/scenarioexcel/**.book.json

翻译说明
如果你想要翻译游戏内容，只需修改剧情脚本相关json文件即可

快捷键
Ctrl 切换快进
Tab 切换自动播放
Alt+Enter 切换窗口化
鼠标右键 隐藏UI
鼠标滚轮 缩放微调
按住鼠标中键拖动 移动微调

讨论与反馈
https://t.me/+wM8U-dHm7ctlMjhl
